cases.case_label: Deep intronic SVA_D insertion in ATP7A causing occipital horn syndrome
cases.mechanism_detail: A 2.8 kb insertion deep within an ATP7A intron activates a new donor splice site located inside the element, producing aberrantly spliced mRNA. Long-read circular consensus sequencing identified the insertion as an evolutionarily old SVA_D. Antisense oligonucleotides against the new splice site restored normal transcript and functional ATP7A protein and reduced copper accumulation in patient fibroblasts; pedigree analysis dated the insertion to two generations earlier.
cases.quote: This insertion caused aberrant mRNA splicing activated by a new donor splice site located within it.
